description: Noise-sized discs packed and relaxed, wrapped by a rubber-band convex hull filled with a rotating linear gradient; discs carry radial gradients.
notable: Rubber-band hull (external tangents + arcs of a disk cluster) filled by a linear gradient whose angle rotates once per loop.

description: Grid of noise-perturbed circles wrapped by a rubber-band hull, linked by 'tendon' bands along rook adjacency; beveled discs with center dots.
notable: Deterministic per-cell perturbation; tendons follow the grid's 4-connectivity adjacency.

description: Figure/ground inversion: a solid color field with the rubber-band hull cut out as a negative shape; tendons extend the cut; clean gradient discs.
notable: The hull and tendons are filled with the void color so they read as carved out of a solid field.

description: Line-only variant: concentric rubber-band hull layers, concentric ring tendons, and concentric rings inside each circle over a max-contrast pair.
notable: Palette reduced to the highest-WCAG-contrast pair; everything drawn as concentric line contours, no fills.

description: Canonical variant: noise-sized discs wrapped by a rubber-band hull, tendon bands to boundary, and 'stipple' beveled discs with lit center dots.
notable: The archetype of the series: bevel-gradient discs with a beveled center dot under a single overhead-left light.

description: Few large noise-driven discs wrapped by a rubber-band hull filled with a rotating linear gradient; reads as one amoeboid form.
notable: Wider margins and larger radii keep the hull from collapsing so a handful of discs merge into a single silhouette.

description: MST-linked discs joined by nested rubber-band 'tendon' bands, each ring lightness- and hue-shifted like a layered Albers color study.
notable: Prim's MST gives minimal-length tendons; concentric bands step lightness/hue for an Interaction-of-Color effect.

description: Pulley/rope schematic: cross-hatched discs hung by strands that wrap tangentially over a master pulley, with rubber-band cross-bracing.
notable: Technical-drawing register: paper/ink two-tone, tangent strands wrapping a master pulley, hatched discs with anchor tabs.

description: Rubber band with convex, concave 'dent', and floater pegs; role-aware tangents, cheapest-insertion + 2-opt to avoid crossings, beveled tube stroke.
notable: Most elaborate of the family: concave dents pull the band inward, floaters auto-insert on crossing, 2-opt removes self-crossings; geometry precomputed (no motion).

description: Minimal study: a rubber band wraps three white discs picked from a 3x3 grid, drawn behind them on near-black.
notable: The seed of the rubber-band series: tangent-line + arc band around three hull discs.

description: Rubber-band diagram framed as a mock technical UI: gear/asterisk/ring glyph discs, a Devanagari label, frame counter, and animated bar meters.
notable: Landscape HUD-style composition: rotating gear/asterisk glyphs and sine-driven pill bars around the rubber-band motif.

description: An equilateral triangle k-means-clustered into convex-hull shards that explode outward with rotation on a keyframed timeline; optional Atkinson dither.
notable: Curtains reveal the triangle, then it fractures via k-means/convex-hull and each shard flies out sized by its area.

description: Two sliding rectangle clusters (base/extension/accent) over a colored column-row grid; overlaps drawn white, triple-overlaps grey; piston-eased motion.
notable: Neighbor-aware coloring of the background grid; overlap/triple-overlap regions recomputed each frame as the clusters slide.

description: Sibling of no-250 stripped to intersections only: overlapping black rectangles on black, visible solely where they overlap (white) or triple-overlap (grey).
notable: Forms exist only as their overlaps — the rectangles themselves vanish into the black ground.

description: Random point clouds in stacked rectangular domains reduced to nested convex-hull polygons, tinted by rampensau hue ramps on a light ground.
notable: Same k-means/convex-hull decomposition as shatter but held static and layered per-domain like torn paper.

description: 4x4 tiling of 16x16 dot grids where color index = floor(dist^scale) mod palette; each tile uses a different scale exponent; hues rotate over the loop.
notable: Concentric-square banding from a distance-power-modulo rule, retiled at escalating scale factors.

description: Single 40x40 dot grid with concentric-square color banding via floor(dist^scale) mod palette; scale factor slowly drifts. Dots or split X/dot mode.
notable: The base version of the distance-power-modulo color-banding idea, over one grid with a creeping scale exponent.

description: Packed verlet soft-bodies (double concentric spring rings) jostle via quadtree collision, then Chaikin-smoothed into a rug of colored blobs.
notable: Soft bodies settle under gravity then, past playhead 0.8, freeze and heavily Chaikin-smooth into rounded fabric-like shapes.

description: Teaching sketch: verlet ring meshes with a central nucleus spring, packed as circles, drawn as visible particles, springs, and outline on white.
notable: Exposes the spring topology (neighbor + nucleus springs, per-particle attraction) rather than hiding it in a fill.

description: Verlet soft-bodies with brute-force O(n^2) inter-body collision, drawn as filled black silhouettes on white under gravity.
notable: The naive collision step (every particle vs every other) that the quadtree sibling optimizes.

description: Quadtree-accelerated verlet collision study: packed soft-bodies with double concentric spring rings settle into filled black blobs on a framed ground.
notable: Radius-query quadtree replaces the O(n^2) neighbor scan; bodies have inner + outer spring rings for firmer shells.

description: 40x40 grid of squares colored in a RYB color model, placed by weighted chance from a 5-hue-step palette with a heavy weight toward near-black.
notable: Uses the rybitten RYB cubes for painterly hue mixing; the folder name echoes Kelly's chance spectrum grids.

description: Weighted Voronoi stippling: points relax toward noise-weighted centroids then back over the loop; cells stroked, colored dots sized by local weight.
notable: Points seeded only where noise is high, migrate to weighted centroids and return; dot diameter encodes cell weight with a bg center hole.

description: Baseline weighted-Voronoi stippling: dots migrate toward noise-weighted cell centroids as the loop plays; cells stroked, centroids marked.
notable: The starter version of the noise-weighted Lloyd relaxation, showing both dots and their centroid targets.
